role: Deterministic appointed-personnel profiles for the oil strategy research department. The eight-axis radar is a preference shape without a total score and resolves into one auditable mandate for the current directional strategy engine.
invariants: players appoint one generated personnel profile and never submit free-form radar dimensions through the service API
the eight style dimensions are preferences and have no total score or higher-is-better interpretation
research institution capability scores never enter the strategy personnel generator or its mandate
contract margin rates, market position limits, market execution capacity, fees, spreads, and base slippage remain external hard owners
the same seed and candidate index generate the same personnel, radar, resolved mandate, and profile hash
all resolved weights are normalized and every resolved parameter remains inside the registered mapping bounds
the profile never reads hidden future prices and never writes back to market or macro state
